description: Supervisory group block for starting, stopping, and monitoring a technological plant section.

inputs.name: IntStart
inputs.description: Start interlock. Must be OK for the group to start.

inputs.name: IntOper
inputs.description: Operating interlock. Must remain OK while the group is running.

inputs.name: IntSwOff
inputs.description: Switch-off interlock. Can inhibit normal stopping.

inputs.name: FbObjOn
inputs.description: Feedback that all related objects are running.

inputs.name: FbObjOff
inputs.description: Feedback that all related objects are stopped.

inputs.name: StartAut
inputs.description: Automatic/program start command for the group.

inputs.name: StopAut
inputs.description: Automatic/program stop command for the group.

inputs.name: QuickStp
inputs.description: Program quick-stop command for the group.

inputs.name: WaitTi
inputs.description: Waiting time before group ON command is issued.

outputs.name: CmdOn
outputs.description: Group ON command, normally used to start connected drives.

outputs.name: CmdOff
outputs.description: Short OFF pulse, mainly used to reset stored start conditions.

outputs.name: PeCmdOn
outputs.description: Continuous ON command while group remains active.

outputs.name: PeCmdOff
outputs.description: Continuous OFF command until group is completely stopped.

outputs.name: RunSig
outputs.description: Group running feedback, TRUE when all related objects are running.

outputs.name: OffSig
outputs.description: Group stopped feedback, TRUE when all related objects are stopped.

outputs.name: Active
outputs.description: Group active from start until complete stop.

outputs.name: QuicStpQ
outputs.description: Quick-stop output command for connected objects.

outputs.name: G_LINK
outputs.description: Group/object link interface used to connect the group to routes, drives, or receive blocks.
